steps.title: One meeting, three phases – hocX supports them all.
steps.lead: The template defines what belongs in every set of minutes. hocX fills in the rest by itself: events, open action items, finances, attendance.
steps.step1Text: Agenda items, upcoming events and open action items from the last meeting are already filled in. Texts can be carried over from the last meeting.
steps.step2Text: Several people write at the same time. Record attendance, capture decisions, assign action items – right inside the agenda item.
steps.step3Text: One click creates the finished document with cover page, table of contents, logo and your colours. Action items go straight to the people responsible.

features.title: Everything your board or management otherwise spreads across five tools.
features.eventsTitle: Events & action items that think ahead
features.eventsText: Events grouped by tags, cancellations in one click. Action items from the minutes keep their origin, owner and due date – including “by the next meeting”.
features.attendanceText: Record attendance and apologies per meeting, document decisions traceably. Balance and transactions appear right in the minutes.
features.submissionText: Reports, receipts, documents: members, employees and partners upload via a secure link. Files are scanned for viruses and land right at the correct event.
features.mediaText: Albums by period and occasion, similar photos grouped, the best one suggested. And shared with partner organisations.
features.importText: Upload entire archives of .docx files. hocX recognises tables, attendance, events and texts – you just review and confirm.

layouts.title: Minutes in your own corporate design.
layouts.text: Choose colours, fonts, header and footer, cover page and table of contents – or upload your own LaTeX building blocks. Every PDF is cleanly typeset and fit for archiving.
